key_catalyst: Escalating US-Iran tensions: Brent crude past $95, Hormuz traffic collapses, Houthi embargo declared
reasoning: The US-Iran conflict has escalated sharply on July 22 with the 11th consecutive night of strikes, Brent crude surging past $95, Houthi embargo threats on Saudi ports, Strait of Hormuz traffic collapsing to 9 ships, and both sides issuing escalating threats. Despite the intraday recovery of +0.35%, the market has not absorbed this severity — oil at these levels with active supply disruption threats poses unresolved forward risk. Rising Treasury yields at 4.65% (highest since May) compound the pressure with stagflation fears re-emerging.
